items.question: With which divine figures should the nine-storeyed structures be adorned?
premises: The nine-storeyed structures are the objects to be adorned.
The Mothers are prescribed as adorning figures.
The lords of gaṇas and vidyās are prescribed as adorning figures.
items.inference: Therefore the nine-storeyed structures should be adorned with the Mothers and the lords of gaṇas and vidyās.
uncertainties: The exact scope of gaṇavidyeśa as a single class or paired classes is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should adorn the nine-storeyed structures with the Mothers and the lords of the gaṇas and vidyās.
